chapter: Altman films and the Metropolitan Room
title: The Metropolitan Room gig with Tardo Hammer and Warren Vache
summary: She describes her weekly gig, the free communication with her musicians and being 80 and having a ball, then they take a break.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: he remembers the key. So I can do anything I want to do. I’ve been there for four years. I look forward to it every week. I can put anything in. I can say, “I’m going to sing something. Follow me.” The ears are big enough. They listen. Warren Vaché, who is a darling, a delight. He and I communicate. Tardo and I communicate. We all communicate with each other, because we listen. I was 80 on my last birthday, and I’m having a ball.
Do you want to take a break?
